text:
neha: Heads-up from a partner SI: odd perf bump on Hopper rigs when running our q4_k flavor with CUDA 12.3 + driver 539.x. Only shows in partner sandboxes that used the community AMI (no driver pin).
todd: ack. Any repro?
neha: repro in partner lab:
```bash
# quick repro
python -m tinybench --model q4_k --seq 96 --device h100 --cuda 12.3 --driver 539.12
```
neha: logs show repeated `attention_kernel fallback -> host copy` and p95 jumps ~18%.
partner-ops: marketplace note: community AMIs often omit kernel-ABI pinning. We need artifacts + tests to push replacement AMIs.
qa-bot: running quick smoke against our internal canary cluster now.
todd: I'll engage vendor for a minimal patched blob and ask for a diff of kernel changes. ETA 4h.
neha: proposed plan: 1) vendor patch + minimal CI, 2) rebuild AMIs/containers with explicit driver pin 537.20 for affected images, 3) staged canary in eu-central-1, 4) partner comms and SI rollback notes.
partner-ops: please include SBOM and smoke logs in the approval request. We can fast-track with full artifacts.
sre-oncall: schedule created: canary eu-central-1 at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z (job can-2002).
qa-bot: canary report: no regressions in median/p95 after patch, small improvement in tail. s3://redwood-canary/can-2002/report.json
neha: draft partner message: "We've identified a narrow interaction between driver 539.x + CUDA 12.3 and certain attention kernels. We're publishing a hotfix and rebuilt images. If you can't apply the patch immediately, pin to driver 537.20 as a temporary mitigation."
todd: owners:
- todd: vendor fix + artifact (ETA 4h)
- neha: partner comms & SI instructions (ETA 6h)
- partner-ops: marketplace approval (on artifact)
- qa-bot: canary & smoke verification
partner-ops: ping me when artifacts land; will loop PM/legal for joint-brand language.
neha: thanks — please keep updates here. If partners surface any customer escalations, tag #sales-support.
